english.title: Enter a Midland Metro vehicle stop without a valid ticket
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) entered a

(A)_[vehicle]_
(B)_[vehicle stop]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System without a valid ticket enabling you to do so or every intention of procuring such a ticket together with proof of the ability to purchase it
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(1) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.

english.notes: A person who contravenes this byelaw shall be liable to pay a penalty fare payable to the operator - see byelaw 4(6) together with section 5(1) of the Midland Metro (Penalty Fares) Act 1991
